title: Phonon dispersion of an atomic chain
caption: For a chain of masses m joined by springs K, ω = 2√(K/m)|sin(ka/2)|. Near k = 0 the curve is a straight line (sound waves, speed set by the slope); at the zone edge, k = ±π/a, it flattens at ω_max = 2√(K/m) = 2.92 × 10¹³ rad s⁻¹ for the silicon-like chain.
alt: Angular frequency against wavevector from minus pi to pi over a: a sine-shaped arch, linear near zero and flat at a maximum of 2.92 times 10 to the 13 at the zone edges.
description: K = 10 N m⁻¹, m = 4.7 × 10⁻²⁶ kg: ω_max = 2√(K/m) = 2.917 × 10¹³ rad s⁻¹.
ω = ω_max |sin(ka/2)| across the first Brillouin zone, −π/a to π/a.
Small k: ω ≈ (a√(K/m))k, sound. Zone edge: the group velocity falls to zero (a standing wave).
